Nitish was very helpful, he helped us to understand the feature and explain everything in detail.
A special mention to Sheetal from Dyson for the wonderful experience she provided. featured_reviews.name: Taran Batra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience at Croma – Infinity Mall outlet.

I purchased not 1 but many product from this store based on the sales team’s assurance about quality and prompt support. Unfortunately, 2 products delivered turned out to be faulty right from the start. What’s worse is the false commitments made at the time of purchase regarding replacement and service turnaround time.

After multiple follow-ups, store staff kept giving vague responses and shifting responsibility instead of resolving the issue. There was a complete lack of accountability and customer care. When you pay full price at a reputed retail chain, you expect transparency and professionalism — not excuses and delays.

Very unprofessional handling of a genuine complaint. I would strongly advise customers to double-check everything in writing before purchasing and not rely on verbal promises.

Truly a frustrating and disappointing experience.

Located inside Jio World Drive, the store feels modern, spacious, and welcoming from the moment you walk in. The staff are friendly, knowledgeable, and genuinely patient, whether you are buying a new device, troubleshooting an issue, or simply exploring products. Visitors can try out iPhones, MacBooks, Apple Watches, and iPads in a relaxed environment without feeling rushed.

One of the best parts of the experience is the events hosted at the store 🎨📱. Apple regularly organizes creative sessions for children where they learn fun skills like drawing on an iPad, helping kids explore creativity through technology in an enjoyable and educational way. These workshops make the store feel more community driven rather than just a shopping destination.

The overall ambience is premium yet approachable, and the store is beautifully maintained. However, it can get crowded during weekends and product launches. Overall, the Apple Store at Jio World offers a memorable experience that blends technology, creativity, and excellent customer service perfectly. It is definitely worth visiting, even without plans to purchase anything at all today.

featured_reviews.name: Shaifa Hirji
featured_reviews.review_text: Great customer service at this Apple Store — the staff were knowledgeable, friendly, and helpful throughout my visit. The only downside was the extended farewell ritual when an employee was leaving; everyone huddled and clapped, which took 5–10 minutes and made customers wait. It felt a little inefficient, especially in a busy customer service setting. Overall, though, a positive experience and the team really knows their stuff.

featured_reviews.name: Mayur Aundhakar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Apple Store — Jio World (Apple BKC) | Detailed Review
Visited the Apple Store at Jio World and it honestly feels like a world-class experience. The design and architecture give a premium “heritage + modern” vibe — huge glass walls, lots of natural light, greenery, and open space. It doesn’t feel like a normal shop; more like a tech gallery.
The staff here is outstanding. They’re polite, patient and actually listen instead of pushing you to buy. They explain features clearly, compare models, and even help with setup, backups, and transfers if you buy a device. You can try every product freely — iPhones, iPads, MacBooks, Watches, AirPods — everything is displayed beautifully.
The store is very organized: • demo tables are spaced nicely
• charging + accessories are easy to find
• billing is quick and seamless (no long queues)
I also liked that they conduct free learning sessions about photography, editing, iPhone tips, etc. — really useful if you’re new to Apple.
Pricing is standard official Apple pricing (not cheap), but you do get genuine products, warranty support, and proper guidance. Service quality easily justifies the visit.
Only downsides: • gets crowded in evenings/weekends
• parking at Jio World can be expensive
• sometimes you may need to wait for assistance
Overall, if you’re planning to buy an Apple product or just explore, this place is worth visiting for the experience alone — premium, calm, and professional.
⭐ Rating: 5/5

featured_reviews.name: Harshal Chaudhari
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited the stunning Apple BKC today! The architecture is incredible, especially that signature timber ceiling. The store is massive, filled with natural light, and the staff were super helpful while I was checking out the latest iPhones. Definitely a must-visit spot in Mumbai for tech lovers. 🍎✨

featured_reviews.name: Adil Syed
featured_reviews.review_text:
Location & Store Presence
The Apple showroom located at Jio World Drive, BKC, enjoys a premium location inside one of Mumbai’s most upscale malls. The store itself is well-sized, spacious, and instantly gives that signature Apple retail feel.

Interiors & Product Presentation
The interiors are spot on—clean, modern, and thoughtfully designed. The way Apple products are displayed is very impressive, allowing customers to explore devices comfortably. Everything feels premium, minimal, and aligned perfectly with Apple’s brand identity.

Overall Buying Experience
From the moment we entered the store until the point of transaction, the staff member assisting us was highly attentive and engaged. He did a good job highlighting the features and positive aspects of the products, which made the initial experience smooth and confidence-building.

Post-Purchase Interaction (Room for Improvement)
However, one important aspect needs attention. After we purchased the iPhone 17 Pro Max, the engagement from the staff member dropped noticeably. As potential customers, we expected some post-purchase interaction—especially regarding accessories. Interestingly, we had already planned to buy accessories, but due to the midway disengagement from the staff, we decided not to proceed with them. A simple follow-up or suggestion could have made a big difference.

Customer Experience & Emotional Connect
In my opinion, Apple showrooms—being part of such a massive and iconic tech brand—should create a small moment of celebration for customers purchasing flagship products like iPhones, MacBooks, or iPads. It doesn’t have to be grand; even a small gesture like offering a cupcake or a simple congratulatory moment would elevate the experience. Inside a showroom representing such a big tech industry, the lack of this emotional connect felt slightly off.

Why These Details Matter
These small touches play a huge role in shaping customer memories. For a brand like Apple, the experience should feel complete from entry to exit. As customers, such details matter a lot and shouldn’t go unnoticed.

Final Verdict
Overall, the Apple showroom at Jio World Drive delivers strongly in terms of location, interiors, and product presentation. The buying journey was good but could be significantly enhanced with better post-purchase engagement and thoughtful customer-celebration moments. With a few refinements in service flow, this store can truly offer a world-class retail experience that matches Apple’s global standards.

featured_reviews.name: Kamlesh Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Apple BKC in Mumbai is India's first Apple store, offering an immersive experience with its stunning design and exceptional customer service. Here are some highlights
- *Design and Ambiance*: The store features a beautiful glass façade, a triangular handcrafted timber ceiling, and stone walls sourced from Rajasthan, creating a modern and elegant atmosphere.
- *Product Display*: The store showcases a wide range of Apple products, including iPhones, Macs, iPads, Apple Watches, and accessories, allowing customers to explore and interact with devices.
- *Customer Service*:
- *Genius Bar*: Offers expert technical support and repair services.
- *Today at Apple*: Free sessions on various topics like photography, music, and Apple software features.
- *Sustainability*: The store is designed to be energy-efficient, running on 100% renewable energy, and is operationally carbon neutral.
- *Staff*: The team comprises 100 members who speak over 20 languages, providing multilingual support to customers.
- *Convenience*: Apple Pickup and delivery options are available, making it convenient for customers to get their products.

Some customers have mentioned areas for improvement, such as
- *Customer Service*: Some staff members seemed disinterested and unhelpful.
- *Crowd*: The store can get crowded, especially during product launches.

Overall, Apple BKC is a must-visit destination for Apple enthusiasts, offering a unique blend of product experience, customer support, and sustainability.

featured_reviews.name: ARQAM
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited the Apple Store BKC regarding a display issue on my MacBook, and I truly want to express my heartfelt gratitude to the entire team.

This laptop was gifted to me by my father after I cleared my CA exams, as a step forward for my future studies. So, it holds a lot of emotional value for me. Naturally, discovering an issue on it was quite stressful.

However, the way your team handled the situation completely changed my experience. Not only was the issue resolved smoothly, but I was also provided with an upgraded replacement without any extra cost. This gesture genuinely meant a lot to me.

This experience has drastically increased my trust in Apple. It clearly shows how much Apple values its customers—something that very few companies truly deliver on. This is exactly how long-term trust and loyalty are built.

I am deeply thankful for the support, professionalism, and kindness shown by your team. Grateful to be a part of the Apple ecosystem.

Thank you once again.
